key_facts.reason_jp: 中東地域のリスク高まりに伴う自己防衛みあい需要により売上高・利益が過去最高を更新

summary_en: Period-end dividend for FY3/27 (year ending March 2027) revised upward. EPS raised to Y268.54 from undisclosed prior forecast, following strong Q1 results (Y85.31 per share vs. Y54.30 forecast) driven by Middle East-linked demand surge in electrical and pipe materials. Full-year sales now forecast at Y48,530M, operating profit Y6,232M, net income Y4,342M.
summary_jp: FY3/27期末配当を修正し増配。中東情勢に関連した電材・管材の需要増で好決算（実績Y85.31/株、予想Y54.30）。通期業績予想：売上Y48,530M、営業利益Y6,232M、当期純利益Y4,342M。
